{{Top|leg}}
'''Taozin amulets''', also called '''Taozin skin nodules''', were amulets made out of an excreted substance that collected on the skin of [[Taozin/Legends|Taozin]]. They blurred and clouded [[The Force/Legends|Force]] senses so their wearers could not be detected easily by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] described attempting to detect a living creature as "almost like encountering a surface so slick that one could find no purchase on it.<ref name=":0">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>

Nodules were semi-transparent, roughly spherical, and approximately the size of a [[Human/Legends|human]] thumb<ref name=":0" /> to a human fist. They were a pale yellow color similar to a [[Rancor]]'s tusk.<ref name=":1">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

Circa [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Lorn Pavan]] possessed a nodule that his droid companion [[I-5YQ]] had obtained from a living taozin that they had encountered in the depths of [[Coruscant]]. He would use it to hide his presence from Maul during an unsuccessful assassination attempt on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]'s life. The artifact's cloaking effect was so effective that Maul could not sense his presence, even while looking directly at him.<ref name=":0" />

Around 18 BBY, [[Gregar Typho]] obtained a nodule from a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] apothecary and used it to ambush [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in an assassination attempt. The apothecary considered it a "rare curiosity."<ref name=":1" /> Not long after this encounter, Vader's [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] began to wear Taozin amulets to mask their presence from the Force-users they hunted.<ref>[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force|''Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force'']]</ref>
